description: EcdsaP256Verifier::verify_signature (line 622) and RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier::verify_signature (line 651) both accept _algorithm without checking the OID. A caller can pass any AlgorithmIdentifier (e.g. ecdsa-with-SHA384 OID) and EcdsaP256Verifier will verify using SHA-256 anyway. In a composable dispatch table this is a latent security issue: if DefaultVerifier's OID dispatch ever has a bug (duplicate OID match, off-by-one), the individual verifiers won't catch the mismatch. Each verifier should assert that algorithm.oid matches its expected OID and return Err(SignatureError::new()) otherwise.
title: EcdsaP256Verifier and RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier ignore algorithm OID
